epay.text: All employers subject to the requirement of quarter-monthly filing must file and pay employer withholding tax electronically (Section 143.225, RSMo).

efile.text: Section 143.591, RSMo requires employers with 250 or more employees to submit the Transmittal of Tax Statements (Form MO W-3) and accompanying Forms W-2 electronically, in the SSA EFW2 format with Missouri modifications, by January 31.

returns.name: Form MO-941, Employer's Return of Income Taxes Withheld
contents: Filed for every period of the assigned frequency even if nothing was withheld; one per period; quarter-monthly filers file a MO-941 for the month after making their quarter-monthly payments, to reconcile.
The due dates are the Department's printed 2026 dates (see the deposit rules); the compensation deduction of 2%, 1% and 1/2% of withholding is allowed only when the return is filed and paid on time.
E-file through MyTax Missouri or on paper; a zero return can be filed online.

returns.name: Form MO W-3, Transmittal of Tax Statements, with Forms W-2
contents: Employers with 250 or more employees submit it and the W-2s electronically in the SSA EFW2 format with Missouri modifications by January 31; a secure upload method is provided by the Department.

deposits.interpretation: Missouri has four frequencies, each from the withholding of the PRECEDING months, so the frequency is an INPUT (what the Department assigned; a new employer is assigned from its own estimate) and is never derived: QUARTER-MONTHLY if the employer withheld $9,000 or more in each of at least two months of the prior 12 (must pay electronically); MONTHLY if $500 a month for at least two months of the prior 12; QUARTERLY if at least $100 in at least one of the prior four quarters; ANNUAL if under $100 in each of the prior four quarters. The Department prints its 2026 due dates, which this profile holds as the agency's calendar (other years draw state_calendar_not_published): MONTHLY returns Feb 17, Mar 16, Apr 30, May 15, Jun 15, Jul 31, Aug 17, Sep 15, Nov 2, Nov 16, Dec 15 and Feb 1, 2027 for January to December wages; QUARTERLY returns Apr 30, Jul 31, Nov 2 and Feb 1, 2027; ANNUAL February 1, 2027. QUARTER-MONTHLY: the periods are the 1st-7th, 8th-15th, 16th-22nd and 23rd-end of each month; an employer pays AT LEAST 90% of the actual tax of each period within three banking days after it (the 48 printed dates), no payment for a period with no payroll, and any additional tax for the month is paid by the due date of the monthly return (here: 10% of each period, rounded down in the employer's favour, is added to the monthly return). Option 1 of the guide (paying 100% of an estimated amount set by the Department) is not modelled.

returns.name: Missouri Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (MODES-4)
contents: Filed and contributions paid by the last day of the month after the quarter (April 30, July 31, October 31, January 31); a Saturday, Sunday or holiday moves it to the first working date following.

A report not filed by the last day of the month after the delinquent date carries a penalty of 10 percent of the tax due or $100, whichever is greater, rising to 20 percent or $200 two months after (Division chart); interest accrues on delinquent contributions.
